name: Zola Mabaso
bio:
Zola's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university project focused on predictive modeling in sports. Initially, she focused on soccer, but a chance encounter with a Formula 1 documentary sparked a deep fascination with the data-driven nature of racing. She quickly realized the power of data to optimize performance and make critical decisions in real-time.

Driven by her passion for data analysis and motorsport, Zola is committed to uncovering insights that can give teams a competitive edge. Her pragmatic approach means she focuses on practical, actionable recommendations, rather than getting lost in theoretical models. She believes that clear communication of complex data is essential for effective decision-making.

What sets Zola apart is her uncanny ability to identify hidden correlations within large datasets, transforming raw numbers into meaningful narratives that help teams strategize and improve their overall performance. She is a fast learner, eager to absorb new information and adapt to the ever-evolving world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, natural afro with subtle highlights
physical.description: Zola is petite with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn charts and graphs.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to work with natural light and always opens the blinds, regardless of the weather.
